filing_larva: Paperwork first. Screaming may be attached as an appendix.
We retain all records and most fingers.
Please hold still while we misfile you.
Your complaint is delicious and lacks supporting documents.
This encounter is automatically renewed every thirty bites.
pipe_goblin: I fixed this pipe personally. That is why it hates you.
Nobody touches the valve except me and the last six explosions.
The leak is tactical. The smell is leadership.
I have one wrench and no remaining doubts.
form_auditor: Your survival request was submitted in the wrong color blood.
I find your continued mobility noncompliant.
This inspection will be thorough, electric, and nonrefundable.
You may appeal after becoming a cautionary diagram.
My promotion proves the system works. Please stop laughing.
Four Claimants, zero appointment confirmations. Appalling.

Dena: I have been criticized harder by furniture.
Was that the attack or a formatting error?
I barely felt that. File another one if it matters to you.
That registered as weather.
The armor would like a real example.
Moss: A mosquito once committed with more confidence.
I felt a rumor of violence.
Adorable. It has discovered verbs.
That barely disturbed my least important spore.
Was I meant to become concerned or merely aware?
Vell: Good news. That fixed a loose buckle.
I have invoices with more impact.
Do it again. Something behind me almost moved.
Barely a ding. Still adding it to your bill.
The wrench has voted not to notice.
Ilex: No treatment required. Possibly for its self-esteem.
I have taken stronger damage from a poorly folded blanket.
Medically speaking, that was a suggestion.
I barely felt that, but I appreciate the diagnostic attempt.
No bruise. One concern about technique.

Dena: That one had weight. Good. Now I know where to stand.
I felt that through three regulations.
Strong hit. Bad follow-through. My turn.
You found the armor. Finding me is the harder portion.
That moved me half a boot. Celebrate responsibly.
Moss: Oh. That was offensively competent.
Excellent hit. I will be growing something in your lungs about it.
That hurt enough to become personal and educational.
I withdraw one percent of my contempt.
Painful. Interesting. Terminal for one of us.
Vell: That rattled a tool I do not remember owning.
Very rude. Structurally impressive, but rude.
I felt that in my emergency emergency pocket.
That hit had torque. I am stealing the technique.
Something cracked. Preliminary finding: probably you next.
Ilex: Significant trauma. I am upgrading you from nuisance to case study.
That was a real hit. Party, adjust before it repeats.
I felt that. Dena, I would like the next one declined.
Strong impact. Its right side opened when it committed.
Pain noted. Treatment pending. Retaliation encouraged.

Dena: T-T-TACTICALLY, THIS IS STILL G-G-GUARDING.
Electric. Ground yourselves and stop touching my shield.
My teeth have achieved formation.
That was not impact. That was weather with intent.
Nobody mention the smoke coming from the helmet.
Moss: I can taste geometry.
Excellent. My skeleton has learned percussion.
Electricity is just lightning trapped in middle management.
My spores are glowing. This is either useful or expensive.
I briefly saw every bad decision Vell has not made yet.
Vell: WHY CAN I HEAR MY WRENCH THINKING?
Electrical. Insulation plan revised from none to urgent.
That charged six coins and one deeply surprised button.
I am fine. My pockets are applauding independently.
Do not ground me through the good tools.
Ilex: Electrical trauma. Check grip, breathing, and accidental prophecy.
That was not a hit. That was an argument with every nerve.
Nobody touch me until the antlers stop humming.
Heart rhythm irregular. Anger rhythm excellent.
I can treat this. I cannot explain why Moss smells like blue.

critical_dealt: That was not a weak point. That was a resignation letter.
Critical hit confirmed. The target has misplaced several future plans.
Did everyone see that? Good. I refuse to provide a reenactment.
Direct structural disagreement. We won the first draft.
That hit found an organ the map denied existed.
The dungeon has marked that impact as unnecessarily persuasive.
Something important left the target without notice.
Critically filed, aggressively stamped, permanently delivered.

Dena: Hit me. The others are doing work above your classification.
You call that a stance? I have seen doors with better threat control.
Come prove the armor department overfunded me.
Eyes here, liability with legs.
Your next attack has been reassigned to someone qualified to receive it.
Moss: I named a fungus after you. It died from embarrassment.
Your aura looks like wet arithmetic.
Come closer. The spores are shy and the infection is not.
I have curses older than your species and fresher than your breath.
Your mother was a perfectly respectable organism. You are the anomaly.
Vell: I have dismantled furniture with a more convincing battle cry.
Your left knee has resale value. Keep approaching.
That weapon still has the shop tag on it, champion.
Fight me. I need to know which pocket gets your dignity.
I can fix anything except your face, and I enjoy exceptions.
Ilex: I know seventeen ways you are about to require medical attention.
Your symptoms include aggression, poor judgment, and imminent bruising.
Come here. This staff performs corrective wellness.
I have already prepared your discharge paperwork.
Your survival prognosis improves dramatically if you surrender now.

enemy_taunt_response: I WAS GOING TO HIT YOU ANYWAY.
Your confidence has been accepted as collateral.
I do not understand the insult, but I resent its posture.
Fine. You first. Then the loud fungus.
That was hurtful and tactically successful.
I have changed targets for personal reasons.
You will regret achieving my full attention.
I will put that sentence back inside you.
My supervisor permits one revenge break.
I have no idea what you said. Prepare to be corrected.
The insult was weak. The targeting effect is unfortunately binding.
strategy: Its attack opens the left side. Expose it before Dena commits.
The electric arc follows metal. Guard the declared target or redirect it.
Weakening matters here. Reduce the hit before spending healing.
Pressure is primed. Vell can turn the whole room into an argument.
That one is nearly done. Do not waste a full Power on paperwork.
Spread the hex while there are two targets left.
The Auditor commits hard before discharge. Taunt can control the target.
Guard first, then let the counterclaim answer.
Expose before Dena strikes. The Edge rewards proper sequencing.
Save healing if Guard absorbs the declared total. We are not paid by the bandage.

conversations.speaker: Vell
conversations.line: Moss, why are your spores spelling my name?
conversations.reply_line: They are drafting a warning label.

conversations.speaker: Dena
conversations.reply_line: Yes. The helmet is also asking about dental coverage.

conversations.speaker: Ilex
conversations.reply_line: Only into a better counterattacking position.

conversations.speaker: Vell
conversations.reply_line: Do not inventory the answer during combat.

conversations.speaker: Moss
conversations.line: Should we tell it that did nothing?
conversations.reply_line: No. Repetition builds confidence and counterattack openings.

conversations.speaker: Vell
conversations.line: Can I have whatever fell off?
conversations.reply_line: You asked before it landed this time. Progress.

conversations.speaker: Dena
conversations.reply_line: I was aiming for its self-esteem. Anatomy intervened.

conversations.speaker: Ilex
conversations.reply_line: No. That is what made it art.

conversations.speaker: Dena
conversations.line: Vell, stop offering enemies resale estimates.
conversations.reply_line: Then they should stop arriving with removable components.

conversations.speaker: Vell
conversations.line: I can rupture the line safely.
conversations.reply_line: Your definition of safely is why I have a shield.

conversations.speaker: Moss
conversations.line: Your shield put my spores in formation.
conversations.reply_line: Then make the formation somebody else's problem.

conversations.speaker: Ilex
conversations.reply_line: To ourselves or to the original inventory?
